newsitem.title: USA: Cascade sets first qtly div $0.10.
newsitem.headline: Cascade sets first qtly div $0.10.

text.p: Cascade Bancorp said on Tuesday it set its first quarterly cash dividend at $0.10 per share payable on August 11 to shareholders of record on August 4.
The company's previous dividend was a one-time special dividend paid on January 29, 1997 of of $0.25 per share, adjusted for a two-for-one stock split.

Cascade Bancorp is the parent company of Bank of the Cascades, a community bank, and Cascade Finance Co -- both of which are headquartered in Bend, Oregon. The bank was founded in 1975 and has eight branches in central Oregon.
